error_coordinates_out_of_range: 错误：坐标超出范围或顺序不正确（需要先纬度后经度）。
invalid_format: 格式无效。请使用 'lat,lng,lat,lng' 或 'lat lng lat lng'。
world_scale_objects_skipped: 低于 0.30 时建筑和道路太小而无法渲染，因此仅生成地形和地表覆盖。
footer_text: © {year} Arnis v{version} 由 louis-e 提供
new_version_available: 有新版本可用！点击这里查看更新内容。
area_too_large: 该区域非常大，可能会超出典型的计算限制。
area_extreme: 此区域极大，可能过大而无法成功生成。
area_extensive: 该区域相当广泛，可能需要大量时间和资源。
select_area_prompt: 使用工具在地图上选择一个区域。
bbox_hint: 使用 {tool} 工具绘制区域
update_modal_download_note: 下载将在浏览器中打开。运行新版本前请先关闭 Arnis。
update_fetch_failed: 无法获取最新版本信息。请检查网络连接或直接访问 GitHub。
facade_mode_java_only: 照片面板是 Java 版实体，因此在 Bedrock 和 Luanti 中只会生成方块外墙。
settings_subtitle: 设置你的 Minecraft 世界的外观和行为。
settings_section_world_desc: 首次进入时世界的玩法。
settings_section_generation_desc: 选择根据真实地图数据构建哪些内容。
settings_section_nature_desc: 地表之下有什么，以及树木如何生长。
settings_section_facades_desc: 用照片制作的纹理装饰建筑墙面。
settings_section_map_desc: 微调所选区域以及用于选择区域的地图。
settings_section_application_desc: 世界的保存位置以及 Arnis 本身的行为。
settings_section_advanced_desc: 用于模组、兼容性和实验功能的选项。大多数世界都用不到。
settings_section_features_desc: Extra controls for very large areas and experimental generation. Off by default.
settings_section_about_desc: Arnis 免费且开源。感谢使用！
gamemode_survival_desc: 在生命值和饥饿值下采集、合成并生存。
gamemode_spectator_desc: 穿过一切飞行，不触碰任何东西。
mode_geo_terrain_desc: 真实地形上的建筑、道路和自然。
mode_geo_only_desc: 平坦地面上的建筑、道路和自然。
mode_terrain_only_desc: 只有真实地形和地表覆盖，没有建筑或道路。
facade_source_off_desc: 墙面使用地图数据中的颜色和材质。
facade_source_preset_desc: 按建筑类型挑选的内置照片。仅限 Java 版。
facade_source_mapillary_desc: 每栋建筑的真实街景照片（如有）。
world_type_desc: 区域边缘之外是什么。仅限 Java 版。
map_item_desc: 开局时背包里有整个区域的地图。仅限 Java 版。
custom_world_name_desc: 自行命名新世界，而不是“Arnis World N”。仅限 Java 版。
overture_desc: 用卫星识别的建筑轮廓填补 OpenStreetMap 的空缺。
three_dmr_desc: 著名地标，以及汽车、船只、起重机和风力涡轮机。
interior_desc: 房间、家具和战利品箱。实验性，生成较慢。
signage_desc: 可读的街道名称、交通标志和店铺招牌。仅限 Java 版。
fillground_desc: 地表下的石头和矿石，便于生存模式采矿。
caves_desc: 丘陵下的洞穴、地下河和洞穴生物群系。
canopy_height_desc: 树木立于真实树木所在之处，高度大致相同。
legacy_trees_desc: 使用简单的程序化树木，而不是精细模型。
max_tree_size_desc: 过高的树会换成较小的树种。
mapillary_token_desc: 可在 mapillary.com/developer 免费获取。仅保存在本机。
facade_mode_desc: 直接挂上照片，或让墙面方块与照片匹配。
facade_detail_desc: 细节越高越清晰，但需要较新的显卡。
facade_precompute_desc: 在生成前预先构建所选区域的立面。
custom_bounding_box_desc: 输入精确坐标，而不是在地图上绘制。
world_scale_desc: 1.00 为真实尺寸。世界越小生成越快。
height_multiplier_desc: 1.00 为真实高度。数值越大，丘陵和山脉越高。
rotation_angle_desc: 旋转区域，使街道与方块网格对齐。
map_theme_desc: 用于选择区域的地图样式。
custom_map_source_desc: 你自己的瓦片服务器，URL 中需包含 {z}、{x} 和 {y}。
anonymous_crash_reports_desc: 发送匿名崩溃数据，帮助改进 Arnis。
java_save_path_desc: 创建新 Java 版世界的文件夹。
bedrock_save_path_desc: 保存 .mcworld 文件的文件夹。
luanti_save_path_desc: 创建新 Luanti 世界的文件夹。
clear_tile_cache_desc: 删除缓存的地图瓦片和立面纹理。
disable_height_limit_desc: 提高高度上限以容纳 1:1 的山脉。不适用于 Realms。
aws_only_elevation_desc: 较旧、较粗糙的高程数据源，在默认源不可用时使用。
bake_lighting_desc: 为 Voxy 等 LOD 模组预先计算光照。生成较慢。
voxy_lod_desc: 首次进入时即可看到远处地形。仅限 Java 版。
enable_luanti_desc: 将 Luanti（Mineclonia）添加为输出格式。实验性。
advanced_features_desc: Shows the options below. When off, Arnis runs as usual.
presets_desc: These settings and the OSM Data Source, as a file.
cpu_usage_desc: Share of the cores generation may use.
threads_desc: Exact number of worker threads. 0 is automatic.
ram_budget_desc: Memory a run may assume, in MB. 0 is automatic.
max_downloads_desc: Downloads kept in flight at once.
one_world_workers_desc: Pieces of a large world built at once. Requires One World.
unit_regions_desc: Regions in each piece; the selection grows to whole cells. Requires One World.
features_group_meld_desc: Changes what gets built: snow, roads, fields, trees, caves and water.
snow_mode_desc: Where snow lies on the terrain.
snow_percent_desc: Share of the height range under snow. Not for One World.
snow_y_desc: Snow lies from this height up.
rocks_desc: Small rocks on open grass and cropland.
bushes_desc: Small bushes on open grass and cropland.
rock_density_desc: Share of chunks that get a rock. Requires Rocks.
bush_density_desc: Share of chunks that get a bush. Requires Bushes.
road_detail_desc: How much road marking and minor ways to build.
no_buildings_desc: Roads, rail, water and land cover only.
loot_table_desc: Loot file for interior chests. Requires Interior Generation.
field_mix_desc: How farmland is split into parcels.
farm_crops_desc: Crop shares for farm plots. Empty keeps the layout's.
field_scale_desc: Parcel size against the layout's own.
tree_weight_small_desc: Share of trees up to 6 blocks tall.
tree_weight_medium_desc: Share of trees up to 12 blocks tall.
tree_weight_big_desc: Share of trees up to 20 blocks tall.
tree_weight_tall_desc: Share of trees up to 28 blocks tall.
cave_seed_desc: A different cave layout per seed. Requires Caves.
cave_datum_y_desc: Lines caves up between areas. Requires Caves.
river_bed_desc: Shape of river, canal and stream beds.
features_group_experimental_desc: Region files, climate, textures, build height, seed and props. Still being tested.
region_format_desc: How Java region files are stored. Not for One World.
blinear_level_desc: Compression from 1 to 22. Higher is smaller and slower.
climate_mode_desc: Where the climate behind ground and biomes is read.
climate_preview_desc: Draws the climate zones of the selected area.
climate_preview_done: Climate zones of the selected area.
grass_texture_desc: Mapped meadows as loose parcels of grass and flowers.
land_texture_desc: Untagged land textured from satellite land cover.
grass_mix_desc: Parcel mix for grassland. Empty keeps the default.
land_mix_desc: Parcel mix for textured cropland. Empty keeps patchwork.
world_floor_desc: Lowest Y of the world. Empty is automatic.
world_ceiling_desc: Highest Y of the world. Empty is automatic.
world_seed_desc: A different but repeatable look per seed.
props_desc: Which bundled props to place: cars, boats, cranes and more.
props_min_scale_desc: No props below this world scale. Empty places them at any.
redraw_map_desc: Repaints the map item over every area. Requires One World.
settings_section_osm_desc: Where map data comes from, and building offline. The defaults are the usual downloads.
osm_source_desc: Where the OpenStreetMap data comes from.
osm_tiles_url_desc: Address of a tile archive. Empty uses Arnis's own.
overpass_url_desc: Servers to ask, comma separated. Empty uses Arnis's own.
osm_file_desc: An .osm, .xml or Arnis .json file covering the area.
osm_pbf_desc: An .osm.pbf extract covering the area. Empty downloads one from Geofabrik.
osm_pbf_bake_desc: Cuts the selected area out of the extract ahead of a run.
offline_mode_desc: Uses only data downloaded before. Fails and lists what is missing.
prewarm_desc: Fetches what the selected area needs, with these settings.
prewarm_first_desc: Downloads each piece's data first, one at a time. Requires parallel pieces.
map_tool_area_desc: 在地图上拖动以选择要生成的内容。
map_tool_rotation_desc: 沿街道画一条线，使世界与之对齐。
map_tool_rotation_one_world: 单一世界模式下不可用。
map_tool_spawn_desc: 点击玩家在世界中开始的位置。
map_tool_clear_desc: 移除所选区域和出生点。
map_tool_world_preview_desc: 将生成的世界叠加到地图上。
map_tool_terrain_desc: 以 3D 显示所选区域的地形。
map_tool_terrain_select: 请先选择不超过 500 km² 的区域。
map_tool_body_desc: 点击在地球、月球和火星之间切换。
map_tool_body_scale: 仅 NASA 地形，1 个方块 = {m} 米。
preview3d_controls_hint: 拖动平移 · 右键拖动旋转和倾斜
preview3d_buildings_too_large: 区域过大，无法显示建筑图层（最大 10 km²）
one_world_desc: 每个区域都按真实位置加入同一个不断扩展的世界。仅限 Java 版。
one_world_foreign: 文件夹“{name}”已存在，但不是单一世界
one_world_no_save_path: 请先在设置中指定 Minecraft 存档文件夹
one_world_confirm_text: 此区域的 {count} 个区块已存在于世界中。它们将重新生成，在 Minecraft 中建造的内容都会被替换。
